content.text: Digital creators often face significant hurdles when trying to sell their design assets online, especially in regions where traditional payment processors like PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-16|Stripe Alternatives]] are unavailable or restricted. In many cases, platforms such as Gumroad impose high fees that can cut into profits, charging around 10% on every sale. However, solutions exist that allow creators to retain a greater share of their earnings by utilizing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-3|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payment-what-actually-10|automated]] crypto payment systems. This post will outline how you can efficiently sell your design assets using a sovereign commerce stack, eliminating the need for traditional payment platforms altogether.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments is a framework that enables digital creators to bypass traditional payment processors and keep more of their earnings. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments, creators can accept cryptocurrency payments directly, incurring only a 0.5% transaction fee compared to the 10% taken by platforms like Gumroad. This shift is essential for creators in regions facing financial constraints, allowing them to maintain full control over their sales, retain complete ownership of their data, and minimize transaction costs, ultimately maximizing their profits.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign commerce stack involves a combination of free and paid tools that work together to create a seamless selling experience. For instance, hosting can be managed through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is executed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders can be stored in services like Supabase or Google Sheets, and products are delivered through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments handles automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring that transactions are confirmed on-chain without the need for buyer accounts, establishing a fully operational online store within days.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This framework is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment solutions are either unavailable or laden with high fees. Whether you are selling ebooks, templates, beats, or software, this system provides the necessary tools to establish an online store that functions independently of third-party platforms. By adopting this approach, you can optimize your revenue stream, enhance your customer experience, and gain sovereignty over your digital commerce operations, thus setting yourself up for long-term success.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully deploy a sovereign commerce stack, several key components must be integrated. First, select a hosting provider, like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, for your online store. Next, implement backend functions using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. Store your order data in Supabase or Google Sheets for easy access and management. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to distribute files efficiently. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, allowing customers to pay in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring you retain more of your profits.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, outline your product offerings and choose the appropriate tools to build your digital storefront. Begin by signing up for services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring you can access and manage them effectively. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle your cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to offer a wide range of payment options while keeping fees low. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a sovereign commerce stack that integrates a hosting platform, a backend service, and a payment processor like NOWPayments. This approach allows you to maintain full control over your sales and significantly reduces transaction fees, ensuring you retain more of your income.
Achieve full ownership over your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you are exploring ways to sell digital assets without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, our Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive resource. It provides all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to establish your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
